description: Workday connector (read-only). Surfaces worker profile, job postings, and time-off requests from the Workday tenant as indexed items in the local index. Authenticates via OAuth2 authorization-code flow; the user supplies NIMBUS_OAUTH_WORKDAY_CLIENT_ID / _SECRET and NIMBUS_WORKDAY_TENANT. The tenant API host is injected at spawn via manifestWithExtraNetworkHosts.
author: Nimbus
